messages.subject: S3 done: fleet/build-s3 @ 04a9e8f
messages.body: Branch fleet/build-s3, head 04a9e8f (committed, not pushed): added tests/test_multi.py (9 tests covering all requested cases plus illegal-marker and --stdout-with-error), cleaned per-file stderr messages ('FILE: no such file' / 'FILE: not valid UTF-8'), and finished the README Usage section (modes, exit codes 0/1/2, marker and fence rules). The S2 CLI already implemented AC-7/AC-9 aggregation, so the new tests passed without a red phase; the only code change was the message wording. Full suite: python3 -m unittest discover, 78 tests OK; SPEC.md untouched; nothing left.
